Answer: B
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates multiple small, discrete nodular opacities scattered throughout both lung fields (random distribution), with some appearing dense enough to suggest calcification. This pattern of diffuse, randomly distributed calcified micronodules is the classic sequela of healed varicella zoster virus pneumonia, distinguishing it from the apical predominance of tuberculosis or the typically non-calcified acute presentation of other infections.
